entities.name: Forest Brothers (Partizanai)
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Europe's longest anti-Soviet guerrilla war: up to 30,000 Lithuanian partisans fought the Red Army and NKVD. The mass deportations of 1948–49 (over 70,000 Lithuanians to Siberia), forced collectivisation, and the NKVD's brutal counter-insurgency campaigns.
